svg.text: M1–M10 are ordinal scores (1–5; higher is more favorable; M8 is an inverse effort score). “—” = unobserved official content detail.

text.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

svg.text: * M7 estimates model prior knowledge. † M11 is composite confidence from M1–M8. For G, CUDA = ROCm/HIP; it is excluded from CANN/CUDA summaries.
